name: @cairn-db/client
description: Client for Cairn, the hybrid search database where a deletion is final

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > dist/cjs/package.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/unit.test.mjs test/live.test.mjs
